schema.text: Do you rarely travel by car because you prefer other ways of getting around, for example for the environment?

ar.#Do you rarely travel by car because you: هل تعود قلّة تنقلك بالسيارة إلى أنك تفضّل طرقًا أخرى للتنقل، مثلًا من أجل البيئة؟

de.#Do you rarely travel by car because you: Fahren Sie selten mit dem Auto, weil Sie andere Arten der Fortbewegung bevorzugen, zum Beispiel der Umwelt zuliebe?

en.#Do you rarely travel by car because you: Do you rarely travel by car because you prefer other ways of getting around, for example for the environment?

fa.#Do you rarely travel by car because you: آیا کم با خودرو سفر می‌کنید چون روش‌های دیگر رفت‌وآمد را ترجیح می‌دهید، مثلاً به خاطر محیط زیست؟

fr.#Do you rarely travel by car because you: Utilisez-vous rarement la voiture parce que vous préférez d'autres façons de vous déplacer, par exemple pour l'environnement ?

hu.#Do you rarely travel by car because you: Azért utazik ritkán autóval, mert más közlekedési módokat részesít előnyben, például a környezet miatt?

it.#Do you rarely travel by car because you: Usi poco l'auto perché preferisci altri modi di spostarti, per esempio per l'ambiente?

tr.#Do you rarely travel by car because you: Örneğin çevre için başka ulaşım yollarını tercih ettiğiniz için mi arabayı nadiren kullanıyorsunuz?
